descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S02 「改 → 复制 → 再改 → 再复制拿到最新的修改；草稿在切换来回之后还在；取消的草稿不被复制；复制时只连本地 host（两种模式）」 Edit → copy → edit again → re-copy gives the latest edit; a draft survives a toggle round-trip; a cancelled draft is not copied; only local hosts are contacted while copying (both contexts)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 After editing the note, 'Copy to EMR' copies the current edited text to the clipboard (a clipboard copy only).（UAT TC-17；TFA-92595 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U5 Editing the note again and re-tapping 'Copy to EMR' copies the latest edited text.（UAT TC-17；TFA-92595 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T2 Copy is clipboard only: no real EHR read or write happens anywhere.（TFA-92595 AC 3；TFA-92595 How it works 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U9 Both modes (ground rule 3.3): TC-17 does not say Hospital-only, so every outcome above must hold in Hospital and in Nursing Home. The ticket has no Hospital/Nursing Home AC (Q3).（UAT 3.3；UAT TC-17） — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Hospital patient in note-ready with note N-H; Nursing Home resident with note N-N (seeded with createRoundingPatient / createSnfResident); a browser context granted clipboard-read and clipboard-write

When Hospital Post-Round: add the line QA-EDIT-1, Save Edits, Copy, read the clipboard (a1); edit to QA-EDIT-2, go to tasks and back to note with the editor open (a2); Save Edits, Copy, read (a3); add QA-EDIT-3, Cancel, Copy, read (a4). Nursing Home: QA-EDIT-N1 → Save Edits → Copy → read (a5); …

Then Each copy holds the whole saved note with the latest saved marker and never the one it replaced; the open editor still holds QA-EDIT-2 after the toggle round-trip; after Cancel the clipboard holds QA-EDIT-2, not QA-EDIT-3; the Nursing Home copies behave the same and never carry the Hospital note; every origin contacted while copying is the local stack

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Scripted Playwright assertions, never an agent's snapshot: after each Copy, page.evaluate(() => navigator.clipboard.readText()) is asserted to contain the marker plus a sentence of the original note (the whole note, not a fragment) and not the replaced marker; a2 asserts the editor's value. a4 reads 'current edited text' as the saved note (Q6). …

在哪跑：本地 newspec-c（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S02 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-17.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-c。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：newspec-c。

UAT item: TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-17/S02

Edit → copy → edit again → re-copy gives the latest edit; a draft survives a toggle round-trip; a cancelled draft is not copied; only local hosts are contacted while copying (both contexts)

Tickets: TFA-92595 Post-Round Review & Completion (in progress)

本地新 lane newspec-c：newspec-c/results.json 里 status passed → 通过（通过）。

怎么测（newspec-c/plan.json，automatable: yes）：New Playwright spec: fresh account, Hospital patient seeded note-ready with N-H, resident seeded with N-N (rounding:add / snf:add then update with note + noteGeneratedAt). Context granted clipboard-read/write. Post-Round: Edit Note, append marker, Save Edits, Copy to EMR, read navigator.clipboard (a1); edit to QA-EDIT-2, go to Tasks and back (a2 editor value); Save Edits, Copy, read (a3); add QA-EDIT-3, Cancel, Copy, read (a4); Nursing Home a5/a6. Every request / WebSocket URL from the first Copy to the last read is recorded and checked against the local allowlist (a7). Billing is answered at the socket (not under test) so no model call is made. A sentinel is written to the clipboard before every Copy and the notice must read 'Note copied to clipboard'. — Clipboard read-back and the request allowlist are both scriptable in Playwright; seeding the note needs only the account's own mutations.

Gated (TFA-92595 in progress). One earlier run under backend overload did not render the SNF saved edit within 15 s (care-setting save error banner); not reproduced since, treated as environment.
